# Incident Report: Overnight Refrigeration Failure at Rosewood Bakery

**Report ID:** RB-2024-017
**Date of Incident:** March 14, 2024
**Prepared by:** Operations Review Committee
**Distribution:** Ownership, Management Team, Facilities Contractor

---

## 1. Summary

At approximately 11:20 p.m. on March 13, 2024, the walk-in cooler at Rosewood Bakery experienced a compressor failure during a scheduled defrost cycle. The failure went undetected until 4:45 a.m. on March 14, when the opening baker arrived and found the cooler interior at 52°F (11°C), well above the safe holding temperature of 41°F (5°C) or below. All temperature-sensitive inventory was discarded as a precaution. No products reached customers, and no illnesses were reported. This report documents the timeline, contributing factors, and corrective actions.

---

## 2. Timeline

**March 13**

- **2:00 p.m.** — Afternoon prep shift begins. Cooler functioning normally; ambient temperature logged at 38°F.
